acceptance_criteria: A deployed container renders the project screen with content, or states plainly that no project-plan source is configured.
If the build context changed, every caller named in what_exists reflects it.
A named test holds the honest-empty behaviour.
The service and frontend suites and the repository privacy gate pass.

baseline.authority: docs/design/UI2_0_B1_01C_CONTAINER_IMAGE_AND_KUBERNETES_DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT.md (FROZEN): the image is built in-cluster and is the unit of deployment, so anything the running service reads is either in the image or supplied to it. A path into a developer checkout is neither.
baseline.observed: On the deployment brought up on HOST-A on 2026-09-15 the project screen renders empty. The service starts cleanly and every other screen works.
baseline.what_exists:
ui2/service/src/main/resources/application.yml:

  ui2:
    project-plan:
      # Empty by default: ProjectPlanConfiguration then locates the repository
      # checkout own project/ directory itself.
      directory: ${UI2_PROJECT_PLAN_DIRECTORY:}

and ProjectPlanConfiguration.java:25 reads that value. In a container there is no checkout to locate, so the source resolves to nothing and the screen has nothing to render. The route is GET /project-plan (ProjectPlanController.java:28).

A previous attempt (movement NXS-LOCAL-0203, never pushed) chose to move the image build context from ui2/ to the repository root so that project/ could be copied in. It changed ui2/Containerfile accordingly and changed nothing else. That is the defect this packet exists to prevent repeating: the build context is named in at least two other places, and a change to it that leaves them alone breaks the in-cluster build that is currently the only way this product is deployed.

The callers of the build context, measured 2026-09-15:

  deploy/ui2-image-build/30-build-job.yaml
      --context=dir:///workspace/ui2
      --dockerfile=/workspace/ui2/Containerfile

  docs/operations/UI2_LOCAL_KUBERNETES_DEPLOYMENT.md, section 3, streams the
  context in with:
      tar -cf - --exclude=node_modules --exclude=.gradle --exclude=build \
          --exclude=.git ui2 | kubectl -n ui2-build exec -i ... tar -xf - -C /workspace

  ui2/Containerfile itself, which copies .ca/ relative to that context.

The in-cluster build was brought up and proven working on 2026-09-15 with the context as ui2/.

invariants: The image stays the unit of deployment and is still built in-cluster.
No credential, address or host path enters the image or a manifest.
Start-up does not begin to fail when the source is absent.
report.merge_gate: The worker opens the pull request and does not merge it.
report.objective: The project screen has its data in a deployed container, and every caller of whatever makes that true is changed with it.
output_contract: A SESSION CLOSE on the relay as one NEXUS_SESSION_PACKET.

recommended_reasoning.reason: The fix is small; the blast radius is not. The work is in choosing between three defensible options and then following the chosen one through every caller, which a previous attempt did not.

requirements: If the build context moves, the build job manifest, the operations procedure and the Containerfile's own relative copies move with it, in this movement. A change that makes something required without taking its callers into scope leaves every test green and the product broken -- it has happened here before, on NXS-LOCAL-0187.

Name the option chosen. Copying published repository data into the image, streaming it in alongside the existing context, and serving it from somewhere else entirely are all defensible; choosing silently is not.
If repository data is copied into the image, say which files and how large.
risks: The in-cluster build is the only path this product is deployed by, and it was proven working today with the context as ui2/. Breaking it to fix a screen is a bad trade, and it is the trade the previous attempt made without noticing.

in: Choose how the deployed service obtains its project-plan data, and say in the pull request which option was chosen and why the others were not.
If the chosen option changes the build context, change every caller listed in what_exists in the same movement, and say how the change was verified.
Make the empty case honest: a service with no project-plan source says so on the screen and in the response. An empty list is an invented certainty and AGENTS.md prefers an explicit unknown.
A targeted test that fails if the deployed configuration resolves to no source without the screen saying so.
out: Mounting a host path into the pod. That reintroduces the workstation-filesystem dependency 01C exists to remove.
Baking a developer machine path into the image or a manifest.
Changing what the project-plan payload contains, or the GET /project-plan contract.
Making a missing source a startup failure. ProjectPlanConfiguration's own comment says it is not one, and that stays true: the absence becomes visible, not fatal.

changed: Kaniko now builds from the streamed repository-root context while retaining ui2/Containerfile.
The image copies six current project-plan files totaling 322931 bytes into /app/project.
The reader emits No project-plan source is configured when all canonical inputs are unavailable.
The Project plan panel renders that warning as an honest empty state.
